snippet.title: Space Mechanic Simulator - Official Steam Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Space Mechanic Simulator is available now on Steam. Watch the trailer to see your objectives and learn more about the game. In Space Mechanic Simulator, players are thrust into the role of a space mechanic tasked with repairing and maintaining various mechanical and electric devices across the Solar System.

#GameTrailers #Gaming #SimulatorGames
